description: NF discovery service operation constraints extracted from the provided 5.3.2.2 text.

constraints.statement: The NF Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the "nf-instances" collection resource URI.
evidence: "The NF Service Consumer shall send an HTTP GET request to the resource URI \"nf-instances\" collection resource."
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required HTTP method and target resource for the API.

constraints.statement: The discovery request shall include the input filter criteria in URI query parameters.
evidence: "The input filter criteria for the discovery request shall be included in query parameters."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable request-format requirement.

constraints.statement: On successful discovery, the NRF shall return 200 OK.
evidence: "On success, \"200 OK\" shall be returned."
constraints.why_interesting: This is the required success status code.

constraints.statement: A successful discovery response body shall contain a validity period.
evidence: "The response body shall contain a validity period, during which the search result can be cached by the NF Service Consumer"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required response field that can be checked in API tests.

constraints.statement: A successful discovery response body shall contain an array of NF Profile objects and/or a map of NFInstanceInfo objects when Enh-NF-Discovery is indicated in the request.
evidence: "The response body shall contain ... an array of NF Profile objects, and/or a map of NFInstanceInfo objects of NF instances (if the NF service consumer indicated support of the Enh-NF-Discovery feature in the request)"
constraints.why_interesting: This defines required response content and a feature-dependent variant.

constraints.statement: If the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to discover the requested NF type, the NRF shall return 403 Forbidden.
evidence: "If the NF Service Consumer is not allowed to discover the NF services for the requested NF type provided in the query parameters, the NRF shall return \"403 Forbidden\" response."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a clear authorization failure behavior.

constraints.statement: If the discovery request fails because of errors in the URI query parameter input data, the NRF shall return 400 Bad Request.
evidence: "If the discovery request fails at the NRF due to errors in the input data in the URI query parameters, the NRF shall return \"400 Bad Request\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required client-error status for invalid query input.

constraints.statement: When returning 400 Bad Request for invalid query input, the NRF shall include ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
evidence: "with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required error payload structure.

constraints.statement: If the discovery request fails because of NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return 500 Internal Server Error.
evidence: "If the discovery request fails at the NRF due to NRF internal errors, the NRF shall return \"500 Internal Server Error\" status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required server-error status.

constraints.statement: When returning 500 Internal Server Error, the NRF shall include ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error.
evidence: "with the ProblemDetails IE providing details of the error."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required error payload structure.

constraints.statement: If the NRF returns a redirection response for discovery, it shall return a 3xx status code.
evidence: "In the case of redirection, the NRF shall return 3xx status code"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required redirect status class.

constraints.statement: If the NRF returns a redirection response for discovery, it shall include a Location header containing a URI to another NRF service instance endpoint.
evidence: "which shall contain a Location header with an URI pointing to the endpoint of another NRF service instance."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable redirect header requirement.

constraints.statement: When the NRF processes a discovery request, it shall ignore unsupported query parameters and continue processing with the remaining query parameters.
evidence: "When certain query parameters in the discovery request are not supported by the NRF, the NRF shall ignore the unsupported query parameters and continue processing the request with the rest of the query parameters."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a normative request-tolerance rule that affects observable results.

constraints.statement: For NF instances with custom NF types, the NRF shall return the customInfo attribute in the NF Profile if it is available.
evidence: "For those NF Instances, the \"customInfo\" attribute shall be returned by NRF, if available, as part of the NF Profiles returned in the discovery response."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required response-field inclusion rule.

constraints.statement: The NRF shall include Vendor-Specific attributes in returned NF Profile objects if those attributes were provided by the registered NF instances.
evidence: "The NRF shall also include, in the returned NF Profile objects, the Vendor-Specific attributes ... that may have been provided by the registered NF Instances."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required response-content rule.

constraints.statement: If the response includes a map of NFInstanceInfo objects and the NF Service Consumer did not indicate Enh-NF-Discovery support, the map of NFInstanceInfo objects shall not be returned.
evidence: "an array of NF Profile objects, and/or a map of NFInstanceInfo objects of NF instances (if the NF service consumer indicated support of the Enh-NF-Discovery feature in the request)"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a feature-gated response constraint.

constraints.statement: In discovery responses toward other PLMNs, the NRF in the home or target PLMN shall not include IP addresses of NF service instances in the NF profiles it returns.
evidence: "shall not include IP addresses of NF (service) instances in NF profiles it includes in NF Discovery Response towards other PLMNs."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a strong cross-PLMN privacy/security restriction.

constraints.statement: If the NRF in the serving PLMN receives a discovery request for a home PLMN and knows that OAuth2-based authorization is required but no access token is included, it may reject the request with 401 Unauthorized.
evidence: "if the request received at the NRF in Serving PLMN does not include an access token, the NRF in Serving PLMN may reject the request with a 401 Unauthorized"
constraints.why_interesting: This is an authorization-related conditional behavior for inter-PLMN discovery.

constraints.statement: For discovery in a different PLMN, the request sent by the serving PLMN shall include the home PLMN identity in the target-plmn-list query parameter.
evidence: "this request shall include the identity of the PLMN of the home NRF in the query parameter \"target-plmn-list\" of the URI."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required cross-PLMN routing parameter.

constraints.statement: For discovery of an AUSF or UDM in a partner PLMN, the NRF shall support the subscription-based routing to a target core network feature.
evidence: "To discover an AUSF/UDM deployed in partner PLMN, the NRF shall support the \"subscription-based routing to a target core network\" feature"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a normative capability requirement tied to a specific discovery scenario.

constraints.statement: For discovery of an SMF in a partner PLMN, the NRF shall support the subscription-based routing to a target core network feature.
evidence: "To discover an SMF deployed in partner PLMN, the NRF shall support the \"subscription-based routing to a target core network\" feature"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a normative capability requirement tied to a specific discovery scenario.

constraints.statement: If a discovered BSF instance's matching BsfInfo object contains serviceScenarioInd, the NRF shall only include BsfInfo objects with the same serviceScenarioInd value in the returned NF profile.
evidence: "the NRF shall only include in the returned NF profile the BsfInfo objects with the same \"serviceScenarioInd\" values as the matched BsfInfo object."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a precise filtering rule on returned profile content.

constraints.statement: In service discovery with an intermediate redirecting NRF, NRF-2 shall identify the next-hop NRF and return HTTP 307 Temporary Redirect.
evidence: "NRF-2 shall identify the next hop NRF ... and redirect the service discovery request by returning HTTP 307 Temporary Redirect response."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required redirect behavior in a multi-NRF topology.

constraints.statement: In service discovery with an intermediate redirecting NRF, the 307 Temporary Redirect response shall contain a Location header whose host part represents NRF-3.
evidence: "The 307 Temporary Redirect response shall contain a Location header field, the host part of the URI in the Location header field represents NRF-3."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a testable redirect-target encoding requirement.

constraints.statement: If NRF-2 does not have enough information to redirect the discovery request, it shall respond with 404 Not Found.
evidence: "if NRF-2 does not have enough information to redirect the service discovery request, then it responds with 404 Not Found"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required failure status for insufficient routing information.

constraints.statement: In service discovery with an intermediate forwarding NRF, NRF-2 shall identify the next-hop NRF and forward the request to that NRF.
evidence: "NRF-2 shall identify the next hop NRF ... and forward the service discovery request to that NRF"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required forwarding behavior in a multi-NRF topology.

constraints.statement: If NRF-2 does not have enough information to forward the discovery request, it shall respond with 404 Not Found.
evidence: "if NRF-2 does not have enough information to forward the service discovery request, then it responds with 404 Not Found"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required failure status for insufficient forwarding information.

constraints.statement: For discovery with target PLMN resolution, the NF Service Consumer shall include gpsi as a query parameter.
evidence: "this request shall include as query parameters the identity of the target UE ... (i.e., the \"gpsi\" query parameter)"
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required request parameter for target-PLMN resolution.

constraints.statement: For discovery with target PLMN resolution, the NF Service Consumer shall include target-nw-resolution set to true.
evidence: "and also a parameter indicating that the resolution of the target PLMN must be performed (i.e., \"target-nw-resolution\" set to true)."
constraints.why_interesting: This is a required request flag for target-PLMN resolution.
